A background for a 2D narrative game, designed like an Art Deco travel poster of the late 1920s and early 1930s, printed as a colour lithograph from a small set of flat poster inks.

Technique: the scene is reduced to large, simple, geometric shapes with crisp clean hard edges and no outlines. Every area is either one flat ink or a smooth, even airbrushed gradient between two neighbouring inks, like the spray-gun gradients of 1930s posters (sky, sea, the lit and shaded sides of the buildings, the tower of the lighthouse). Forms are stylised and streamlined: long horizontal bands, clean arcs and circles, straight diagonals, stepped terraces. The rocks of the headland are drawn as stepped, faceted geometric blocks with flat light and shadow sides. The low clouds are two or three long, thin, streamlined horizontal bands with rounded ends, in flat violet and coral tones. The calm sea is a stack of long parallel horizontal bands of deep teal and midnight blue, getting lighter towards the horizon. The buildings are clean geometric volumes: the sides facing the sunset in warm coral and cream, the sides in shadow in flat cool violet and blue. A few thin gold-ochre accent lines: the rim of the sun disc, the railing of the lighthouse gallery, the window frames, the lantern frame. Elegant, calm and monumental, with a low viewpoint and a strong silhouette of the lighthouse against the sky.

Palette: only about eight poster inks: midnight blue, deep teal, dusty violet, plum, warm coral orange, pale cream, terracotta red, and gold ochre; the darkest colour is a deep blue-black, never pure black.

Sky: a smooth airbrushed gradient from midnight blue at the top through violet and plum to a warm coral-orange band at the horizon. The upper half of a large, pale gold setting sun disc sits on the horizon a little left of the centre (at about 40 % of the image width). The sky around the sun is a plain smooth gradient: no sun rays, no light beams, no stars and no birds (all of these are added and animated separately by the game).

On the right, from about 70 % of the width to the right edge, a stepped rocky headland rises from the sea, with a slender, tall white lighthouse with one red band on it; the top of the lighthouse reaches up to about 10 % of the image height. The lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing gold spot, without any beam or rays. On the left, from the left edge to about 22 % of the width, the stone harbour-master's cottage stands on the quay, with a steep roof, one warmly lit gold window, a door and a chimney; no smoke from the chimney (smoke is animated separately). The flat, paved top of the stone quay runs as a horizontal band across the whole width between about 66 % and 84 % of the image height, seen from slightly above; the middle third of this band, from about 25 % to 60 % of the width, is completely empty and free of objects, because the player character walks there. A short wooden jetty leads from the quay out into the water at about 55 % to 68 % of the width, with two small wooden fishing boats moored beside it on the water. On the quay: an iron lantern on a wooden post at about 62 % of the width, standing on the back edge of the quay; two barrels, a stack of crates and a coil of rope at the right end of the quay, from about 80 % to 98 % of the width. Below 84 % of the image height only the plain stone face of the quay wall and a narrow strip of dark water (this area will be covered by the game's text panel). No reflections of lights on the water (added separately).
